'''Ronald Fonck''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 24 from Joliet, Il. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
